name: Lesson 9 · More than one: the plural of nouns

cards.note: Plural of nouns. Many der-words add -e. In the plural the article is always die, whatever the gender.
Plural of nouns. der Tisch → Tische: -e, no umlaut.
Plural of nouns. der Tag → Tage.
Plural of nouns. das Jahr → Jahre. Jahre alt is the full way to give an age.
Plural of nouns. Some words add -e and an umlaut: Stuhl → Stühle.
Plural of nouns. der Zug → Züge: u becomes ü.
Plural of nouns. die Stadt → Städte: a becomes ä, plus -e.
Plural of nouns. der Baum → Bäume: au becomes äu.
Plural of nouns. Many das-words add -er: Kind → Kinder. The verb is plural: spielen.
Plural of nouns. -er comes with an umlaut where it can: Buch → Bücher.
Plural of nouns. das Haus → Häuser: umlaut plus -er.
Plural of nouns. das Land → Länder. viele: many, with a plural.
Plural of nouns. das Bild → Bilder: -er, no umlaut possible.
Plural of nouns. das Ei → Eier.
Plural of nouns. das Glas → Gläser: a becomes ä, plus -er.
Plural of nouns. Most die-words add -n or -en: Frau → Frauen.
Plural of nouns. A word in -e adds only -n: Katze → Katzen.
Plural of nouns. die Frage → Fragen.
Plural of nouns. ein has no plural: a flower, but just flowers — Blumen with no article.
Plural of nouns. die Flasche → Flaschen. German needs no word for of here.
Plural of nouns. die Tomate → Tomaten.
Plural of nouns. A die-word in -el adds -n: Kartoffeln.
Plural of nouns. Words in -ung always add -en: Zeitungen.
Plural of nouns. -in doubles its n before -en: Freundinnen.
Plural of nouns. Words ending in a vowel other than -e, often from other languages, add -s: Autos.
Plural of nouns. das Handy, the German word for a mobile, takes -s: Handys.
Plural of nouns. das Foto → Fotos.
Plural of nouns. der-words in -er add nothing: der Lehrer, die Lehrer. Only the article shows the plural.
Plural of nouns. das Zimmer → die Zimmer: no ending.
Plural of nouns. Words in -en add nothing: Kuchen.
Plural of nouns. -chen words never change: das Mädchen, die Mädchen. das, because -chen makes every word neuter.
Plural of nouns. Some der-words in -er only add an umlaut: Bruder → Brüder.
Plural of nouns. der Apfel → Äpfel: umlaut only.
Plural of nouns. die Tochter → Töchter: umlaut only. ihre, as ein would have in the plural.
Plural of nouns. der Junge → Jungen: masculine words in -e add -n.
Plural of nouns. die Eltern only exists in the plural; the possessive takes -e: meine.
Plural of nouns. Geschwister: brothers and sisters together, a plural with no ending.
Plural of nouns. kein has a plural: keine Kinder, while ein has none.
